project.name: VexelRay :: msdf-atlas-gen for Windows
project.description: msdf-atlas-gen.exe, the tool vexelray-msdf-maven-plugin generates font atlases with, and META-INF/vexelray/msdf-atlas-gen.properties saying where it is. The plugin's OS-activated profile puts it on the plugin's class path; on an OS with no such module the plugin uses the committed atlases instead.
